raw_segments.text: As he spoke, he handed her the cup.
Minerva thought it very right and proper of him to have given it to herself first.
Twenty-seven, she accordingly began praying heartily to Neptune.
O thou, she cried, that encirclest the earth, vouchsafe to grant the prayers of thy servants
More especially we pray thee send down thy grace on Nestor and on his sons.
Thereafter also make the rest of the Pylian people some handsome return for the goodly
Lastly, grant Telemachus and myself a happy issue, in respect of the matter that has brought
us and our ship to Pylos.
